sections.heading: Our commitment
body: Real Broker, LLC is committed to the letter and spirit of the Fair Housing Act. We support equal housing opportunity for everyone.
We do not discriminate in the sale, rental, financing or advertising of housing. We do not steer anyone toward or away from a home or area because of a protected class.

sections.heading: Equal Housing Opportunity
body: We are pledged to the letter and spirit of U.S. policy for the achievement of equal housing opportunity throughout the Nation. We encourage and support an affirmative advertising and marketing program in which there are no barriers to obtaining housing because of race, color, religion, sex, disability, familial status, or national origin.

sections.heading: Federal protected classes
body: The federal Fair Housing Act (42 U.S.C. 3604) protects people from housing discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin and disability. HUD applies the protection for sex to sexual orientation and gender identity.

sections.heading: Additional protections in Maryland, DC and Virginia
body: Maryland (State Government Article, section 20-705) protects race, color, religion, sex, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, source of income and military status.

The District of Columbia (D.C. Code sections 2-1401.01 and 2-1402.21) protects race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, disability, source of income, sealed eviction record, status as a victim of an intrafamily offense, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, a sexual offense or stalking, place of residence or business, and homeless status.

Virginia (Va. Code section 36-96.3) protects race, color, religion, national origin, sex, elderliness, source of funds, familial status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military status and disability.
The law in your area may give more protection. This list is a summary and not legal advice.

sections.heading: Report a concern
body: If you think you faced housing discrimination on or through Cribstop.com, write to contact@cribstop.com.
You can also file a complaint with the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) or with your state or local fair housing agency.
